%@ meta id=railway_rescheduling family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Railway Timetable Rescheduling with Flexible Stopping and Short-Turning
%@ desc :: MILP for railway rescheduling minimizing passenger delay. Includes retiming, reordering, cancelling, flexible stopping (skipping/adding), flexible short-turning, and platform track assignment.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of trains.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of stations.
%@ index P ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of platforms.
%@ index I ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of passenger demand groups/connections.
%@ param d_demand shape=I kind=scalar domain=non_negative :: Passenger demand weight for group i.
%@ param delay_penalty shape=I kind=scalar domain=non_negative :: Penalty per unit delay for group i.
%@ param arrival_orig shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time_duration :: Original scheduled arrival time of train t at station s.
%@ param departure_orig shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=time_duration :: Original scheduled departure time of train t at station s.
%@ param min_dwell shape=T,S kind=scalar domain=time_duration :: Minimum required dwell time for train t at station s.
%@ param travel_time shape=T,S,S kind=matrix domain=time_duration :: Travel time for train t between station s and s_next.
%@ param weight_delay shape=I kind=scalar domain=non_negative :: Weight of delay for passenger group i.
%@ var t_arr shape=T,S domain=non_negative role=primary drole=timing lo=- hi=- :: Actual arrival time of train t at station s.
%@ var t_dep shape=T,S domain=non_negative role=primary drole=timing lo=- hi=- :: Actual departure time of train t at station s.
%@ var x_skip shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=decision lo=0 hi=1 :: 1 if train t skips station s.
%@ var x_cancel shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=decision lo=0 hi=1 :: 1 if train t is cancelled.
%@ var x_short shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=decision lo=0 hi=1 :: 1 if train t short-turns at station s.
%@ var x_plat shape=T,S,P domain=binary role=primary drole=decision lo=0 hi=1 :: 1 if train t uses platform p at station s.
%@ var x_reorder shape=T,T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=decision lo=0 hi=1 :: 1 if train t precedes train t_prime at station s.
%@ var delay_p shape=I domain=non_negative role=primary drole=delay lo=0 hi=- :: Delay experienced by passenger group i.
%@ obj sense=min name=min_passenger_delay combination=sum :: Minimize total weighted passenger delay.
%@ con dwell_constraint kind=linear domain=- :: Ensures minimum dwell time if station is not skipped.
%@ con travel_constraint kind=linear domain=- :: Ensures travel time between consecutive stations.
%@ con skip_consistency kind=linear domain=- :: If a train is cancelled, it must skip all stations.
%@ con short_turn_logic kind=linear domain=- :: Short-turning logic constraints.
%@ con platform_assignment kind=linear domain=- :: Each train must be assigned to exactly one platform if not cancelled.
%@ con platform_conflict kind=linear domain=- :: Prevents two trains from using the same platform at the same time.
%@ con passenger_delay_calc kind=linear domain=- :: Calculates delay for passenger groups.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} \mathit{delay\_p}_{i} \cdot \mathit{weight\_delay}_{i} \tag{min\_passenger\_delay} \\
  & t_{dep, t, s} - t_{arr, t, s} \ge \mathit{min\_dwell}_{t, s} \cdot (1 - x_{skip, t, s}) \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T}, \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{dwell\_constraint} \\
  & t_{arr, t, s_{next}} \ge t_{dep, t, s} + \mathit{travel\_time}_{t, s, s_{next}} - \mathcal{M} \cdot x_{skip, t, s} - \mathcal{M} \cdot x_{skip, t, s_{next}} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T}, \forall s, s_{next} \in \mathcal{S} \tag{travel\_constraint} \\
  & x_{skip, t, s} \ge x_{cancel, t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T}, \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{skip\_consistency} \\
  & \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} x_{plat, t, s, p} = 1 - x_{cancel, t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T}, \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{platform\_assignment} \\
  & t_{arr, t, s} \ge \mathit{arrival\_orig}_{t, s} - \mathcal{M} \cdot x_{cancel, t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T}, \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{passenger\_delay\_calc} \\
  & \mathit{delay\_p}_{i} \ge t_{arr, t, s} - \mathit{arrival\_orig}_{t, s} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I}, \forall t \in \mathcal{T}, \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{passenger\_delay\_calc} \\
\end{align}

%@ meta id=railway_rescheduling family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Railway Timetable Rescheduling with Flexible Stopping and Short-Turning
%@ desc :: MILP model to minimize passenger delay under disruptions. Decisions include retiming, reordering, cancelling, flexible stopping (skipping/adding), and flexible short-turning. Includes platform track constraints and time-dependent passenger demand weights.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of trains.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of stations.
%@ index P ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of platforms.
%@ index I ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of time intervals.
%@ param demand shape=T,S,I kind=matrix domain=non_negative :: Passenger demand weight for train t at station s during interval i.
%@ param delay_weight shape=T,S kind=scalar domain=non_negative :: Penalty weight for delay of train t at station s.
%@ param arrival_sched shape=T,S kind=scalar domain=non_negative :: Scheduled arrival time of train t at station s.
%@ param departure_sched shape=T,S kind=scalar domain=non_negative :: Scheduled departure time of train t at station s.
%@ param travel_time shape=T,S,S kind=matrix domain=non_negative :: Travel time between stations for train t.
%@ param min_dwell shape=T,S kind=scalar domain=non_negative :: Minimum dwell time for train t at station s.
%@ param capacity shape=P,S,I kind=matrix domain=non_negative :: Platform capacity/availability.
%@ var arrival shape=T,S domain=non_negative role=primary drole=timing lo=- hi=- :: Actual arrival time.
%@ var departure shape=T,S domain=non_negative role=primary drole=timing lo=- hi=- :: Actual departure time.
%@ var skip shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=decision lo=0 hi=1 :: 1 if train t skips station s.
%@ var short_turn shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=decision lo=0 hi=1 :: 1 if train t short-turns at station s.
%@ var cancel shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=decision lo=0 hi=1 :: 1 if train t is cancelled.
%@ var platform_use shape=T,S,P domain=binary role=primary drole=decision lo=0 hi=1 :: 1 if train t uses platform p at station s.
%@ var delay shape=T,S domain=non_negative role=primary drole=timing lo=0 hi=- :: Delay of train t at station s.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_passenger_delay combination=sum :: Minimize total weighted passenger delay.
%@ con dwell_constraint kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure minimum dwell time if not skipped.
%@ con travel_constraint kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure travel time between consecutive stations.
%@ con delay_definition kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Link arrival time to scheduled time and delay.
%@ con platform_assignment kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure train uses exactly one platform if not cancelled or skipped.
%@ con platform_capacity kind=linear domain=- indicator=- :: Limit number of trains per platform per station per interval.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, s \in \mathcal{S}, i \in \mathcal{I}} \mathit{demand}_{t,s,i} \cdot \mathit{delay}_{t,s} \tag{total\_passenger\_delay} \\
  & \mathit{departure}_{t,s} - \mathit{arrival}_{t,s} \ge \mathit{min\_dwell}_{t,s} \cdot (1 - \mathit{skip}_{t,s}) \cdot (1 - \mathit{short\_turn}_{t,s}) \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T}, \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{dwell\_constraint} \\
  & \mathit{arrival}_{t,s'} - \mathit{departure}_{t,s} \ge \mathit{travel\_time}_{t,s,s'} - \mathit{M} \cdot \mathit{skip}_{t,s} - \mathit{M} \cdot \mathit{skip}_{t,s'} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T}, \forall s, s' \in \mathcal{S} \tag{travel\_constraint} \\
  & \mathit{delay}_{t,s} \ge \mathit{arrival}_{t,s} - \mathit{arrival\_sched}_{t,s} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T}, \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{delay\_definition} \\
  & \sum_{p \in \mathcal{P}} \mathit{platform\_use}_{t,s,p} = 1 - \mathit{skip}_{t,s} - \mathit{cancel}_{t} \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T}, \forall s \in \mathcal{S} \tag{platform\_assignment} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} \mathit{platform\_use}_{t,s,p} \le \mathit{capacity}_{p,s,i} \qquad \forall p \in \mathcal{P}, \forall s \in \mathcal{S}, \forall i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{platform\_capacity} \\
\end{align}

% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Railway timetable rescheduling with flexible stopping, short‑turning, retiming, reordering and cancellation.
%@ meta id=rail_reschedule family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Railway disruption recovery model
%@ desc :: MILP that decides for each train whether to stop at a station, to short‑turn, to shift its schedule, to reorder with other trains or to cancel, while respecting platform capacities and minimizing passenger delay costs.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of trains.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of stations ordered along the line.
%@ param demand shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=- :: Passenger demand (weight) of train i at station j.
%@ param arr0 shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=- :: Scheduled arrival time of train i at station j.
%@ param travel shape=T,S kind=matrix domain=- :: Travel time of train i from station j to the next station.
%@ param stop_time shape=- kind=scalar domain=- :: Additional dwell time when a train stops at a station.
%@ param cap shape=S kind=vector domain=- :: Number of platform tracks available at station j.
%@ param bigM shape=- kind=scalar domain=- :: Large constant for big‑M formulations.
%@ param penalty_cancel shape=- kind=scalar domain=- :: Cost of cancelling a train.
%@ param penalty_delay shape=- kind=scalar domain=- :: Cost per passenger‑minute of delay.
%@ var x shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=stop lo=- hi=- :: 1 if train i stops at station j, 0 otherwise.
%@ var y shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=shortturn lo=- hi=- :: 1 if train i short‑turns (terminates) at station j, 0 otherwise.
%@ var shift shape=T domain=continuous role=primary drole=retiming lo=0 hi=- :: Time shift applied to the whole schedule of train i.
%@ var arrival shape=T,S domain=continuous role=primary drole=arrival lo=0 hi=- :: Actual arrival time of train i at station j.
%@ var delay shape=T,S domain=continuous role=primary drole=delay lo=0 hi=- :: Passenger delay of train i at station j.
%@ var cancel shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=cancel lo=- hi=- :: 1 if train i is cancelled, 0 otherwise.
%@ obj sense=min name=obj_total_delay combination=sum :: Minimize weighted passenger delay plus cancellation penalties.
%@ con canc_stop kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: If a train is cancelled it cannot stop.
%@ con canc_shortturn kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: If a train is cancelled it cannot short‑turn.
%@ con platform_cap kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Platform capacity at each station.
%@ con shortturn_consistency kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Short‑turn decision forces no stops beyond the turn point.
%@ con arrival_start kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Arrival time at the first station after retiming.
%@ con arrival_propagation kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Arrival time propagation along the line.
%@ con delay_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Definition of passenger delay.
%@ con delay_nonneg kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Non‑negativity of delay.
%@ con cancel_delay kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Zero delay when a train is cancelled.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{T}, j \in \mathcal{S}} \mathit{demand}_{i,j} \cdot \mathit{delay}_{i,j} \;+\; \mathit{penalty\_cancel} \cdot \sum_{i \in \mathcal{T}} \mathit{cancel}_{i} \tag{obj\_total\_delay} \\
  & \mathit{x}_{i,j} \le 1 - \mathit{cancel}_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall j \in \mathcal{S} \tag{canc\_stop} \\
  & \mathit{y}_{i,j} \le 1 - \mathit{cancel}_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall j \in \mathcal{S} \tag{canc\_shortturn} \\
  & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{T}} \mathit{x}_{i,j} \le \mathit{cap}_{j} \qquad \forall j \in \mathcal{S} \tag{platform\_cap} \\
  & \mathit{x}_{i,k} + \mathit{y}_{i,j} \le 1 \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall j \in \mathcal{S},\; \forall k \in \mathcal{S},\; j < k \tag{shortturn\_consistency} \\
  & \mathit{arrival}_{i,1} = \mathit{arr0}_{i,1} + \mathit{shift}_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{T} \tag{arrival\_start} \\
  & \mathit{arrival}_{i,j} = \mathit{arrival}_{i,j-1} + \mathit{travel}_{i,j-1} + \mathit{stop\_time} \cdot \mathit{x}_{i,j} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall j \in \mathcal{S},\; j \neq 1 \tag{arrival\_propagation} \\
  & \mathit{delay}_{i,j} \ge \mathit{arrival}_{i,j} - \mathit{arr0}_{i,j} - \mathit{bigM} \cdot (1 - \mathit{x}_{i,j}) \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall j \in \mathcal{S} \tag{delay\_def} \\
  & \mathit{delay}_{i,j} \ge 0 \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall j \in \mathcal{S} \tag{delay\_nonneg} \\
  & \mathit{delay}_{i,j} \le \mathit{bigM} \cdot (1 - \mathit{cancel}_{i}) \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall j \in \mathcal{S} \tag{cancel\_delay} \\
\end{align}
